name: git-sync-notifier
description: Notifies you when your branch falls behind the default upstream branch, and merges only when you ask.

gitSyncNotifier.enabled.description: Enable background checks for upstream commits. Disabling also hides the status bar item.

gitSyncNotifier.pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to fetch from origin and compare against the default branch. Minimum 1 minute.

gitSyncNotifier.remote.markdownDescription: Remote to compare against, e.g. `upstream` for a fork. Leave empty to auto-detect: an `upstream` remote is preferred (the repository your fork came from), otherwise `origin`.

gitSyncNotifier.remoteBranch.markdownDescription: Branch on `origin` to compare against, e.g. `main` or `release/2.x`. Leave empty to auto-detect from `origin/HEAD`, falling back to `main` then `master`.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
